g.text: CampusClaw Session Event Direct POST Stream
context headers and message or fileIds JSON
validate sessionId and strict request body
current model, thinking, and execution state
append ordered fileIds as fixed text block
resolve current model and input policy
persist User MessageEntry and mark active execution
clear active execution and persist final entries
retain completed entries and clear active execution
Message previews and tool execution events are transient.
User, completed Assistant, and ToolResult entries are authoritative.
Completed Thinking entries are authoritative when the execution
snapshot has thinking true; thinking started and delta are transient.
Session idle and stream end are non-history control events.
Stream error is a terminal non-history event and closes the response.
This POST has no application idempotency key.
After disconnect, do not replay it automatically; call GET Session Events.
The accepted execution continues without the HTTP client.
